text: This solution, Building Resilience to Climate Change in Papua New Guinea (BRCC) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Papua New Guinea between Government of Papua New Guinea, Climate Change and Development Authority (CCDA), Provincial and local governments across ARoB, East New Britain, Manus, Milne Bay, and Morobe, Asian Development Bank (ADB), Climate Investment Funds (CIF), Government of Australia, PNG Ports Corporation Limited, National Maritime Safety Authority (NMSA), National Information & Communications Technology Authority (NICTA), and Particip GmbH. The program was implemented in 2015 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and regulation.
